name: Replace afconvert CLI with AVAudioConverter in AudioStore

references.text: AVAudioConverter: Convert streams of audio between formats using native Swift frameworks. Format ID for M4A: kAudioFormatMPEG4AAC
Implementation pattern: 1) Read CAF with AVAudioFile, 2) Create AVAudioConverter (PCM → MPEG4AAC), 3) Convert buffers in chunks, 4) Write to M4A, 5) Clean up CAF temp file
Reference: Apple Developer Forums thread on AVAudioConverter usage for audio format conversion

summary: Use native Swift frameworks instead of subprocess for CAF to M4A conversion
